headline: Cristiano Ronaldo announces Portugal retirement after 23-year international career
summary: The legendary forward, Portugal's most decorated player, has stepped down from international duty, ending an illustrious career that saw him win Euro 2016.
details: Cristiano Ronaldo, Portugal's all-time leading scorer and appearance holder, has announced his retirement from international football. The 41-year-old forward confirmed his decision on Thursday, bringing an end to a storied 23-year career with the national team.

Ronaldo captained Portugal to their historic Euro 2016 victory, their first major international trophy, and also helped them secure the 2019 and 2025 Nations League titles. He leaves the international stage as Portugal's most successful player, having become a cultural icon for the nation.

In a heartfelt statement, Ronaldo expressed that the decision was made with both his head and heart. He thanked his family, the Portuguese people, and all the teammates, coaches, and staff he worked with throughout his extensive international journey.

The Al-Nassr forward holds numerous international records, including the most international appearances and goals scored. He recently became one of only two players, alongside Lionel Messi, to feature in six World Cups.

Ronaldo's final international tournament was the 2026 World Cup, where Portugal was eliminated in the Round of 16. His international career was not without controversy, including a recent suspension and fine for disciplinary issues.

The Portuguese Football Federation released a statement acknowledging Ronaldo's profound and eternal gratitude for his services, calling him an inspiring leader and the ultimate symbol of the national team's soul.

headline_marked: BNP leader's son [[shot dead in Khulna]] at tea stall
headline: BNP leader's son shot dead in Khulna at tea stall
summary: Tarikul Islam Sheikh, 35, was killed by helmeted gunmen on a motorcycle who shot him in the head while he was having tea.
details: Tarikul Islam Sheikh, 35, was shot dead by unidentified gunmen at a tea stall in the Ambhita-Ramkrishnapur area of Dumuria Upazila, Khulna, on Thursday.
The victim was the son of Abdus Salam Sheikh, the BNP convener of Rangpur Union, and was a businessman by profession.
Witnesses report that two helmeted individuals on a motorcycle arrived at the tea stall, spoke to Tarikul for a short while, and then shot him in the head, killing him instantly.

According to Rangpur Union Parishad Chairman Samaresh Mondal, Tarikul had left home to attend a program of the Prime Minister in Khulna but returned to the tea stall after failing to find a seat on a bus.
The father of the victim, Abdus Salam Sheikh, expressed his grief, stating that politics had taken everything from him.
Dumuria Police Station OC Khondakar Hafizur Rahman confirmed that police have reached the scene and are conducting investigations and raids to identify the killers.
Data from the Khulna Metropolitan Police and district police show a rise in violence; 77 people have been killed in the Khulna region in the first 10 months of this year.
Police statistics indicate that 39 people were killed in the city area and 38 in the district area, with a significant increase in murder cases compared to previous years.
caption:
A BNP leader's son was shot dead in the head at a tea stall in Khulna by helmeted gunmen.

Tarikul Islam Sheikh, 35, was shot dead by unidentified gunmen at a tea stall in the Ambhita-Ramkrishnapur area of Dumuria Upazila, Khulna, on Thursday.

The victim was the son of Abdus Salam Sheikh, the BNP convener of Rangpur Union, and was a businessman by profession.

Witnesses report that two helmeted individuals on a motorcycle arrived at the tea stall, spoke to Tarikul for a short while, and then shot him in the head, killing him instantly.

According to Rangpur Union Parishad Chairman Samaresh Mondal, Tarikul had left home to attend a program of the Prime Minister in Khulna but returned to the tea stall after failing to find a seat on a bus.

The father of the victim, Abdus Salam Sheikh, expressed his grief, stating that politics had taken everything from him.

Dumuria Police Station OC Khondakar Hafizur Rahman confirmed that police have reached the scene and are conducting investigations and raids to identify the killers.

Data from the Khulna Metropolitan Police and district police show a rise in violence; 77 people have been killed in the Khulna region in the first 10 months of this year.

Police statistics indicate that 39 people were killed in the city area and 38 in the district area, with a significant increase in murder cases compared to previous years.
